relations: The active flame cluster on the right flickers and tilts, growing and shrinking as it burns the charred ground.
Smaller isolated flame patches in the foreground glow and dim, continuing to burn without obvious new fronts.
Translucent white smoke rises from the right fire and smoldering ground, drifting upward and spreading through the haze.

caption: The video captures a wide, low-light landscape under a pale pink, smoky sky, where fire already burns across charred ground. A bright cluster of active flame flickers on the right, its tongues growing, shrinking, and tilting in roughly the same area. Smaller isolated flame patches glow and dim in the left-center and lower-center foreground, continuing to burn and flicker. Translucent columns of white smoke rise from the right fire and smoldering ground, drifting upward and spreading through the haze. This haze veils the scattered trees, some leafy and others bare or scorched, across the midground. A dirt track curves through the lower-left foreground, while trees, ground, and framing appear largely unchanged, suggesting little camera movement. The visible fire patches continue burning, without obvious new fronts or extinguished flames.
